# The build frontend and the build backend of every distribution this repository builds, at fixed
# versions (owner choice A on 2026-10-26, order DELTA-PREPARE-640-BAUWEG-FEST-01).
#
# WHY. The isolated build environment takes the newest setuptools that `[build-system] requires`
# allows, and the wheel records it (`Generator: setuptools (X)` in `*.dist-info/WHEEL`). Measured on
# 2026-10-26 at 58de280a with Python 3.12.15 and build 1.6.1, the way release.yml builds: setuptools
# 84.2.1 gives the wheel ccefd4fd, setuptools 80.9.0 gives b40dc656, the sdist is 202d5cfa in both.
#
# HOW IT IS READ. Every workflow step that installs the frontend or builds sets PIP_CONSTRAINT to this
# file. `python -m build` installs `[build-system] requires` with a plain `pip install`, and that reads
# PIP_CONSTRAINT: measured with pip 25.0.1 and with pip 26.2.2. PIP_BUILD_CONSTRAINT alone did not pin
# it (measured with pip 26.2.2), although pip 26.2 reads only that variable for its own isolated
# builds. After the build, `build_reproducible.py --expect-backend-from` refuses a wheel whose
# generator is not the setuptools named here, so a later change in pip or build cannot drop the pin
# without a red step.
#
# THE WHOLE RESOLVED SET, not only the three names: what the frontend and the build environment
# installed on 2026-10-26 under these pins.
build==1.6.1
packaging==26.3
pyproject_hooks==1.3.3
setuptools==84.2.1
wheel==0.48.0
